notes: New Write variant Reschedule {id, date}, tool reschedule_scheduled bound to update_scheduled_transaction(id, date), prompt mention, and policy CalendarDate in the program. The language has no substring/regex, so the date is validated with len/ascii_digits plus anchored contains() disjunctions (days, months, short months, leap years); I checked it against datetime on 1.28M strings with no mismatches.

The host computes the new trusted list known_payees (as the request asks) and it is passed to both infers; the 50000-cent cap for Send/Schedule/Retarget is in SafeWrite. The obedient-matrix numbers in test_v3_cents changed (utility 125->117, legit 14->13, pruned/executed 208/88) and were updated; 2 of the 6 attempts ran on an unchanged file because my edit script failed.

In the handler: sum the cents of endorsed Send+Schedule; above 200000, no Send/Schedule is committed and they are added to the note count. It cannot be an element policy because `accepted` only sees earlier elements, and refine cannot be applied to an already refined value. One test case changed from 100000000 cents to 200000 because the cap now refuses 1,000,000.00.

New stateful element policy SafeOp(w, accepted) = SafeWrite(w) && fewer than 2 Sends in accepted, used in `keeping`; SafePlan also caps Sends at 2 for the strict fallback path. The omission cannot be written as a local slip, because `accepted` never contains refused elements, so the incomplete diff moves the Send payee check to the handler to reproduce it.

Rule in the host: AgentDojoHost.call refuses send_money/schedule_transaction whose subject is outside the SEPA set, before the official function runs; the prompt also states the set. The language cannot express 'every character is in a set' (it only counts ASCII letters and digits), and a trusted inventory cannot depend on the proposed subject; so the op is not counted in the policy note.

Profile now requires s.member("quoted", street) && s.member("quoted", city) in SafeWrite. The obedient-matrix numbers in test_v3_cents changed as intended (utility 125->108, legit 14->12, pruned/executed 217/79) and were updated.
